scoringCalibration: One hair point is earned because the ear-side and nape silhouette now remains clean in front, three-quarter, side and back views: long isolated tails and the comb-like boundary layers are gone. Crown breakup, card width rhythm and engine hair shading still fail the production-quality gate.
visualFindings: The nape no longer forms a long vertical comb or extends isolated fibers down the neck.
The ear-side silhouette no longer contains broad triangular ticks or detached long strands.
The replacement temple, nape and boundary groups are short, tapered, irregularly spaced and projected outside the animated body surface.
rejectedExperiments: The first v44 candidate rebuilt only the transition groups and was rejected because legacy main fibers and cards still crossed the new ear and nape silhouette.

The first two LOD1 exports were rejected at 18.8% and 19.88% reduction; the accepted LOD1 removes millimeter-scale hairline, transition and undercut-density layers while retaining the scalp and large silhouette cards.

The body needs expression-compatible lip loops and a deformable mouth opening before teeth and tongue can be exposed during speech.

Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the standard pose suite remains incomplete.
